title: Commerce Tax Rate
description: One row of the store's tax table

country.label: Country
country.help: The country this rate is for. Everywhere is a rate for buyers in any country that has no rate of its own.

region.label: Region
region.help: A state or province, such as NY. Leave empty for the whole country. For the United States and Canada the code and the full name both match what a buyer types. Anywhere else, write it each way a buyer might, with commas between: NSW, New South Wales.

label.label: Label
label.help: What the buyer sees on the order, such as Sales tax or VAT.
